info.name: Indonesian Document Verification API
info.description:
Driver & vehicle document OCR + verification (KTP/SIM/STNK/KIR).
Set collection variables `baseUrl` and `apiKey`.
Every 4xx/5xx body follows the same ErrorResponse shape.

request.description:
API Root

Root endpoint that provides basic information about the API and links to documentation.
    
    This is the main entry point for the OCR API service. It provides version information
    and links to the interactive API documentation.

Prometheus Metrics

Expose Prometheus metrics in text-based format.
    
    This endpoint provides metrics in Prometheus format for monitoring the application.
    It's used by Prometheus to scrape application metrics.
    
    ### Security
    - This endpoint is not protected by API key authentication to allow Prometheus scraping.
    - It can be disabled via the `METRICS_ENABLED` environment variable.

Health Check

Health check endpoint that returns the status of the service with version and timestamp.
    
    This endpoint can be used by monitoring systems to verify that the API is operational.
    It returns detailed status information including service health, version, and configuration.
Per-doctype frame geometry + quality spec for building a guided capture UI
Reference standard (quality criteria) for collecting new document photos

Health check endpoint for monitoring.

Returns:
    Dict with service status information

Process document from file upload

Process an uploaded document image using OCR.
    
    This endpoint accepts image files (JPEG, PNG, WebP) containing documents and returns
    the extracted text along with structured data based on the document type.
    
    ### Supported Document Types:
    - KTP (e-KTP): Indonesian ID card
    - SIM: Indonesian driver's license
    - STNK: Indonesian vehicle registration
    - KIR: Vehicle roadworthiness certificate
    
    ### Rate Limiting
    This endpoint is rate limited. Check response headers for rate limit information.

Parse provided OCR lines (no OCR step)

Developer utility to test the parsers by sending lines directly. Response data is normalized: data.fields.<key> is an object {value, confidence}.

Process document from URL

Process a document image from a URL using OCR.
    
    This endpoint accepts a publicly accessible URL to an image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP) 
    containing a document and returns the extracted text along with structured data 
    based on the document type.
    
    ### Supported Document Types:
    - KTP (e-KTP): Indonesian ID card
    - SIM: Indonesian driver's license
    - STNK: Indonesian vehicle registration
    - KIR: Vehicle roadworthiness certificate
    
    ### Rate Limiting
    This endpoint is rate limited. Check response headers for rate limit information.
    
    ### Security
    - Only HTTP/HTTPS URLs are allowed
    - Maximum file size: 10MB
    - Image dimensions must not exceed 5000x5000 pixels

Verify uploaded document against claimed identity

Uploads an image and compares extracted fields to claimed identity attributes (e.g., NIK, name, DOB). Returns OCR data plus a verification block with score and decision.
